thread.title: Qualcomm: Apple $7B behind in royalties - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Yoel Minkoff
title: Qualcomm: Apple $7B behind in royalties - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
If Qualcomm ever prevails in its patent dispute with Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ), it could have significant compensation coming its way.
The chip designer disclosed in San Diego federal court that Apple was allegedly $7B behind in device royalty payments, revealing the scale of claims against its former customer.
Apple sparked the legal battle in early 2017 with a $1B lawsuit accusing Qualcomm of double-dipping on patent royalties.
